architecture: same learned shared-world/local-view factorization with per-view decoders

conditions.R_x_R: shared world scalar + local view scalar, both Euclidean
conditions.R_x_S1: world Euclidean, view encoded cyclically as (cos phi, sin phi)
conditions.S1_x_R: world encoded cyclically as (cos theta, sin theta), view Euclidean
conditions.S1_x_S1: world and view both cyclic; toroidal product topology

goal: Isolate whether the benefit comes from cyclic world structure, cyclic view structure, or the product of both.
name: CWR topology ablation: R×R vs S1×R vs R×S1 vs S1×S1
